text:
maria: FYI - Nimbus private renewal invoice just went out (inv #987654) but the platform_fee line looks wrong. We agreed to reduce nodes from 10 -> 6 on 2026-02-01; invoice shows full-capacity fee for the quarter. Can someone confirm before I escalate? :thinking:

dan_adams: I see it. Pulling the invoice now. Do we have the signed amendment that changed node counts?

maria: Signed amendment sent by jlee on Jan 12, 2026. SOW section 3.2 covers proration. I pasted the relevant clause below.

jlee: Confirmed - amendment 2026-01A. Proration should be pro-rata by day, so Feb should be ~40% at new rate.

maria: Exact values from contracting: platform_fee monthly = $15,000 at 10 nodes, $9,000 at 6 nodes. So quarterly proration should reduce the platform_fee line by ~$18k across the invoice period. Invoice shows platform_fee = $45,000 instead of expected ~$27,000.

invoice-bot: Automated invoice generation: inv 987654 created 1769475199 by billing-service. Line items:
```
PLATFORM_FEE    $45,000    sku:platform_fee.standard    period:2026-01-01 -> 2026-03-31
SUPPORT_TIER     $12,000    sku:support-premier        period:2026-01-01 -> 2026-12-31
```

ndan_adams: Hmm - looks like billing-service didn't pick up the amendment effective date. Could be a metadata tag on the customer record. Pointing to billing team to check `customer_metadata.effective_amendments`

jlee: Also note support tier: customer downgraded from Premier -> Standard on 2026-02-15 per ticket #3412, which should have reduced support charges and may trigger a credit. The invoice still shows Premier. Likely two separate metadata misses.

maria: So two issues in one invoice: platform_fee not prorated and support tier not applied. Customer already on PO hold and asked for invoice correction before payment. They escalated to their procurement today.

dan_adams: I'll open a billing-ops runbook task. Short term options: 1) issue a corrected invoice/credit memoir, 2) apply a temporary manual credit and adjust next invoice, 3) hold and wait for system fix (not ideal). Which do we prefer?

jlee: Legal prefers corrected invoice + credit memo to keep audit trail clean. Tanya, any concerns?

tanya_legal: Corrected invoice + credit memo is fine. Make sure the credit references amendment ID and support downgrade ticket. Also include a short explanation line for auditors. No waiver of platform fee without signed confirmation.

dan_adams: Got it. Action plan: (a) billing-ops will regenerate invoice with amendment effective 2026-02-01 and support tier change effective 2026-02-15, (b) if regeneration not possible before EOD, issue credit memo for the overcharge amount, (c) ops to confirm GL mapping and reversal codes. I'll tag billing-ops and accounting for approvals.

maria: Please include the customer contact loop: cc procurement@corp.nimbus and acctmgr@redwood. Customer wants this done before EOD tomorrow or they'll escalate to their finance director.

dan_adams: Noted. I'll draft the credit memo text and post here for review before we send. Draft will include: "Credit issued for platform fee proration per amendment 2026-01A and support tier adjustment per ticket #3412."

jlee: One ask: can we also run a quick audit query to ensure no other customers had amendments in Jan/Feb missed by the ingest job? Might be a bulk issue.

dan_adams: Good call. I'll run `select count(*) from invoices where amendment_tag IS NULL and amendment_effective_date between '2026-01-01' and '2026-02-28'` and share results in #finance-alerts if >0.

maria: Thank you. Please update thread when you have the regenerated invoice or the credit memo draft. Customer is breathing down my neck. :grimacing:

invoice-bot: Follow-up: billing-service job "amendment-sync" failed at 1769475120 with transient DB timeout. Retry scheduled.

dan_adams: That explains it. I'm bumping the retry, and billing-ops will proceed with manual credit memo if retry doesn't complete in next 2 hours.

maria: Appreciate the quick triage. Keep me posted and I'll coordinate with Nimbus procurement. :thumbsup:
